critical_code_review_comments: leave_room (server.py:838) is mostly a duplicate of end_room_session (server.py:790) for the owner branch. Extract a private _wipe_and_archive(room_id, user) helper to follow DRY.

summon_room filters status='active' so ended rooms are correctly hidden — confirmed by test_owner_leave_sets_status_ended_and_wipes. However, /api/rooms/{id}/end (non-owner) does NOT set status='ended', meaning if an owner non-owner pair ping-pong the End button, the room stays alive forever. Behavior is by design per iter-4 spec but worth surfacing in product copy.

mark_message_read condition `read_by.issuperset(other_members)` is correct, but if room.members has only the sender (e.g. the other member already left), other_members=[] -> condition is False and message lingers. Consider treating empty other_members as 'auto-delete' since there is no one else to read it.

ConnectionManager.broadcast iterates over a snapshot but does not catch send exceptions — a stale websocket can silently drop subsequent broadcasts to other clients. Wrap each send in try/except in a future iteration.
Frontend Logo.tsx still uses style.resizeMode — react-native-web emits a deprecation warning. Move to <Image resizeMode='contain' .../>.
